{{Top|leg}}
'''Fal'Orssk''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Fal'Orssk always wore [[stun gauntlet]]s while on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with strict weapons laws. Fal'Orssk also believed that [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]] were effective weapons because, unlike [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], slugthrowers could be silenced. Fal'Orssk also left comments on the entries for the [[GLX Firelance]] and the [[VES-700 pulse rifle/Legends|VES-700 Pulse Rifle]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
